description.raw:
This spell functions like protection from evil, except that the deflection and resistance bonuses apply to attacks made by chaotic creatures. The target receives a new saving throw against control by chaotic creatures and chaotic summoned creatures cannot touch the target.Mythic Protection from ChaosSource Mythic Adventures pg. 104
As mythic protection from evil, except against chaotic creatures.
